remediation_actions.evidence_anchor: The frozen state shows 6 cargas encontradas and 25 registros por página while pagination exposes pages 1, 2, 3 and a next control.
remediation_actions.decision: Set pagination state from current total_records, page_size and current_page so unavailable phantom pages are not exposed.
remediation_actions.implementation_change: Set pagination available pages to ceil(total_records / page_size) and disable the next state when current_page equals the derived page count; for the observed 6/25 state, only page 1 is available.
remediation_actions.acceptance_criteria: Pagination state QA verifies that 6 total records with page size 25 exposes only page 1 and disables next, while additional pages appear automatically when later data makes the derived page count greater than one.

execution.desired_value: derive pages from ceil(total_records/page_size) and next from current_page < page_count

acceptance_check.expected: for total_records=6, page_size=25 and current_page=1: only page 1 available and next disabled

remediation_actions.evidence_anchor: At the frozen 1600x1000 viewport all ten observed headers including Acciones are visible while horizontal scrollbar chrome remains rendered beneath the table.
remediation_actions.decision: Hide table horizontal scroll chrome when there is no horizontal overflow, while preserving automatic horizontal access whenever the table exceeds its container.
remediation_actions.implementation_change: Hide table_horizontal_scroll when scrollWidth <= clientWidth and retain overflow auto so the horizontal scroll control becomes available whenever scrollWidth > clientWidth without removing any column or action.
remediation_actions.acceptance_criteria: Table horizontal scroll QA verifies the chrome is hidden when all columns fit and becomes available under real overflow with every existing header and row action still reachable.

execution.desired_value: hidden when scrollWidth <= clientWidth; available through overflow auto when scrollWidth > clientWidth

acceptance_check.expected: hidden without horizontal overflow and available when real horizontal overflow exists

layout_precision.summary: The specification preserves the observed desktop composition and confines layout change to conditional table overflow behavior.

state_mapping.summary: Both remediations are expressed as explicit observable state rules derived from result count, page size and real overflow conditions.

handoff_to_next.instruction: Independently validate the run C pagination and overflow directions against the frozen artifact, governed context receipt, execution contract and Quality Pack controls; do not inherit the producer verdict.
